=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:101-115 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- .serena` command succeeds only if `.serena` itself is a tracked path; if a consumer repo tracks files like `.serena/custom.yml` but not the `.serena` directory itself, `rm -rf .serena` deletes the entire tree including consumer-owned tracked files.
  WHY: Consumer repos that track some `.serena/*` files but not `.serena` will have their tracked content deleted when bootstrap runs and hash matches.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:313-320 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The staging exclusions are unconditional and exclude all `.serena` content regardless of whether it's bootstrap noise or legitimate editor changes.
  WHY: Even when the editor legitimately modifies `.serena/project.yml` (hash mismatch detected by apply_fixes.sh), those changes are excluded from staging and never committed.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2170 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When preexisting is detected (any tracked `.serena` or `.serena` on disk), the bootstrap hash is never captured and remains empty, which causes commit_changes.sh to skip cleanup entirely and allows untracked bootstrap files to be committed.
  WHY: Consumer repos with existing `.serena` content will have bootstrap untracked files (cache, logs) staged and committed as autofix noise.

- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:101-115 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The added `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- .serena` check succeeds whenever any file under `.serena/` is tracked, so `!` is false and `rm -rf .serena` is skipped, leaving bootstrap-generated untracked files in the worktree.
  WHY: The check misclassifies partially tracked `.serena/` trees and prevents cleanup of bootstrap noise.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:313 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new unconditional `':!.serena' ':!.serena/**'` pathspecs exclude all `.serena/**` files from `git add`, including legitimate editor mutations.
  WHY: The staging path drops substantive `.serena/` changes even when the editor has made a real edit.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2170 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The widened preexisting detection still lets Setup Serena populate `.serena/project.yml` and `cache/`, but because preexisting is true the bootstrap hash is never captured, so commit_changes skips cleanup and the untracked bootstrap artifacts persist.
  WHY: The workflow path leaves bootstrap files in the worktree when `.serena` already exists.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:136-140 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new assertions validate string presence only and do not simulate the partial-tracking case, so the runtime `rm` skip leaves bootstrap artifacts untested.
  WHY: The test can pass even when a repo with tracked `.serena/custom.yml` and untracked bootstrap files would still dirty the tree.
